name: Fukushuu ~Ryoujoku no Yaiba~
source:
Nakazawa Yuuichi has been bullied without reason since childhood. In order to change his circumstances, he transfers to another school. Unfortunately, he ends up being bullied again, this time by a bunch of girls. One day, a girl named Iida Yui comes to his rescue but consequently becomes a target herself. They support each other through emails and become close, but their happiness is short-lived. Yuuichi is restrained by his bullies and forced to watch as Yui is sexually assaulted before his eyes. He decides to take revenge.

[Translated and condensed from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=3940]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
中泽祐一从小便无缘无故地遭受欺凌。为了改变处境，他转学到了另一所学校，却不幸再次成为欺凌对象，而且这一次欺负他的是一群女孩。某天，名叫饭田唯的女孩出手救了他，却因此也成了她们的目标。两人通过电子邮件互相支持，关系逐渐亲近，可这份幸福并没有持续多久。祐一被霸凌者按住，只能眼睁睁看着唯在自己面前遭到性侵。于是，他决定展开复仇。

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=3940]Getchu[/url]并经压缩]
